## User problem

Who is affected and in which situation?

## Proposed behavior

What should the app do? Include important loading, empty, error and permission states.

## Acceptance criteria

- Given … when … then …

## Boundaries

Affected Android/iOS behavior, API/schema changes, offline expectations and what is outside
the request. Mark unknown product decisions rather than silently making them requirements.

## Existing references

Related feature, issue, design node or code pattern. Describe why alternatives fall short.
